subject: Re: GTM coverage seat rebalance — Q3 prioritization
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 04 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: rebalance GTM coverage seats for Q3

Team —

Quick note to propose a temporary rebalance of three open GTM seats ahead of Q3 planning. Summary:

- Ask: repurpose two unfilled AE postings and one pending SDR req toward 1 Solutions Engineer (SE) and 2 AE roles in the Pacific time zone to cover the new ACMECloud expansion in the West.
- Why: ACMECloud (lead: Lisa Park) is in active pilot and needs a solution-focused SE to close the product-technical gap; projected ARR acceleration of $420k ARR within 12 months if we assign dedicated pre/post-sales support.
- Tradeoffs: delaying SDR hires in EMEA and pushing one AE search to late Q3. See attached Q3_GTM_Coverage_Prioritization.xlsx for modeling (ramp curves, expected quota attainment, and cost delta).

Ask: Marcus/Marissa/Laura — can we get approval to reallocate these reqs and create the SE JD + immediate req in Greenhouse? If approved, I’ll loop in BrightHire to speed sourcing and coordinate an expedited offer band review with People Ops.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Sr. Sales Strategy Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Q3_GTM_Coverage_Prioritization.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 04 May 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: rebalance GTM coverage seats for Q3

Vanessa —

Thanks for the write-up and the attached model. A couple of clarifying questions before I can sign off:

1) Ramp timing: Your sheet shows an SE fully ramped at 6 months and AEs at 4 months; can you surface the underlying assumptions (ramp % by month, quota relief needed)?
2) Opportunity evidence: Can you attach the pilot notes from Lisa at ACMECloud (emails or call summary) so we can validate the conversion probability?
3) Cost neutrality: If we pull 1 SDR and postpone 1 AE, what's the net comp & burden delta for Q3–Q4?

Cc'ing Laura for workload/priorities alignment. If answers look reasonable, I'm open to a conditional green light (finance to confirm run-rate impact).

- Marcus
VP, North America Sales

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 04 May 2027 14:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: rebalance GTM coverage seats for Q3

Marcus/Team —

Attached a short memo (see seat_tradeoff_notes.pdf) with the ramp/blend assumptions and the ACMECloud pilot notes copied below. Key points:

- Ramp assumptions: SE = 50% of target at 3 months, 85% at 6 months; AE = 40% at 3 months, 75% at 6 months. SDR assumed 60% productivity month 4 onward after handoffs.
- Conversion evidence: Lisa Park confirmed a second technical POC and an internal stakeholder demo scheduled for 5/20 — she's signaled that product validation is the gating factor for a $350–500k expansion depending on integration timelines. I included the email excerpt from Lisa under the pilot notes section of the PDF.
- Budget impact: Reallocation yields a net comp & burden delta of +$18k for FY27 (one-time recruiting & relocation levers), which Finance has flagged as manageable within our hiring envelope if we delay two EMEA SDRs into early Q4.

Recommendation (ordered):
1) Approve reallocation of two AE reqs + one SDR -> create 1 SE + 2 AE reqs in Greenhouse; mark two EMEA SDR reqs as deferred to Q4.
2) SE offer band: Align to Sr. SE band (base $155k–$175k, OTE $220k–$250k); Marissa, please confirm if you accept the band or want People Ops looped for market comp.
3) Contingency: If ACMECloud pilot slips past 6/1, rollback and re-open EMEA SDRs.

I'm comfortable approving pending Marissa's band confirmation and a brief note from People Ops certifying the one-time delta.

—Laura
Head of GTM Operations

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 05 May 2027 11:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: rebalance GTM coverage seats for Q3

All —

I reviewed the deck and Laura's memo. I approve the reallocation on the following conditions:

1) SE band confirmed as listed (base $155k–$175k, OTE $220k–$250k). If we need to push to the top of band for an exceptional profile, get my explicit sign-off.
2) Quick note from People Ops confirming the one-time comp & recruiting delta and sign-off on urgent Greenhouse req creation.
3) Vanessa to run a 30/60/90 plan for the SE role and share with Marcus + me before offer stage.

Please loop in BrightHire (raj@brighthouse.com) to accelerate sourcing; cc People Ops on the req creation email. Once People Ops confirms the band and the drive link is attached I’ll stamp with final approval.

Thanks — Marissa
SVP, Revenue Operations

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: raj@brighthouse.com
Date: Wed, 05 May 2027 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: rebalance GTM coverage seats for Q3

Perfect — thank you. I’ll: 

- Draft the SE 30/60/90 and JD today and create the Greenhouse req (REQ-5721) with "urgent" tag.
- Loop People Ops for the band confirmation and routing to BrightHire (cc'd).
- Share a short summary to the exec hiring channel once req is live.

I'll attach the pilot email excerpt and the People Ops note once received.

—Vanessa
Sr. Sales Strategy Manager
Redwood Inference
